# VidyBack

> AI-powered social media content generator that turns e-commerce product catalogs into branded videos and posts automatically.

VidyBack connects to your Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, Jumpseller, Etsy, or Ecwid store and automatically generates Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and social media posts from your existing product catalog — no video editing or design skills required.

## Use Cases

- Auto-generating Instagram Reels and TikTok videos from product photos for Shopify and WooCommerce store owners
- Automating social media content creation for DTC brands and solo ecommerce founders without a dedicated marketing team
- Keeping social posts synced with live product catalog changes (pricing, inventory, new arrivals)
